verdict.rationale: BugSnag's error-status docs show fixed, snoozed and ignored states, with actions available from the dashboard (including keyboard shortcuts) and from Slack. Its automatic error assignment rules cover assigning owners. However, no evidence shows that a fixed error automatically reopens when it regresses, which is a core part of the story. Missing for 10: documented automatic reopen-on-regression behavior, explicit manual assign-owner action docs, independent or hands-on corroboration of the triage workflow.
